exposure: exposure to a farm environment during pregnancy
outcome: proportions of arachidonic acid (20:4 n-6) and adrenic acid (22:4 n-6) in cord serum
fatty acid levels in maternal diet, serum, and breast milk (around 1 month postpartum)
cohort: The study included infants (n=55) born to mothers who lived in a farm environment (n=26) or a non-farm environment (n=29) during pregnancy as part of the FARMFLORA birth-cohort.
finding: Infants born to Farm mothers had significantly higher proportions of arachidonic acid and adrenic acid in their cord serum compared to infants born to non-Farm mothers, suggesting an association between a farm environment during pregnancy and fetal fatty acid composition.
